note: Attacker-controlled mp4a sample entry box is parsed from the input file; its payload contains a wave box (with a nested esds box) followed by a malformed box.
Parses the mp4a child boxes. The wave box is parsed as a GF_UnknownBox and its nested esds box is parsed into wave->child_boxes.
The wave box's on_child_box handler sets ptr->esd to the esds box that lives inside wave->child_boxes (nested), so ptr->esd aliases a box owned by the wave box.
The trailing malformed box (size 5 < 8) makes gf_isom_box_array_read return an error, so control enters the 'hack' fallback path below.
The raw mp4a payload is scanned for an 'esds' 4CC; the nested esds box is found in the raw bytes.

gf_isom_box_del_parent is called on ptr->child_boxes (mp4a top-level list), but ptr->esd is NOT in that list (it is in wave->child_boxes). gf_list_del_item is a no-op, then gf_isom_box_del(b) frees the esds box, leaving a dangling pointer in wave->child_boxes.
The esds box is freed here while the wave box still holds a reference to it in its own child_boxes list.
During cleanup the wave box is deleted; gf_isom_box_del recursively deletes wave->child_boxes, which still contains the freed esds box pointer.
Reads a->registry from the already-freed esds box -> heap-use-after-free READ of size 8 (ASAN crash).
